title: Training Note: Clean Debit-Card Record Allowance for Portal Payments (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Training note for collectors on **Placed Consumer Accounts**: the portal debit-card clean-record allowance, which depends on whether any debit-card payment on the account has ever come back.

## The rule

The portal debit-card clean-record allowance is:
- **$200.00** where no debit-card payment on the account was ever returned and one or more debit-card payments were received in the last three months;
- **$100.00** where no debit-card payment on the account was ever returned and none was received in the last three months;
- **nothing** where a debit-card payment on the account was ever returned.

The allowance is added, at its full amount, in working out the portal debit-card ceiling of the day.

## Questions and answers

**What counts as a debit-card payment ever returned?** Any returned-payment entry on the account's money history, at any date, on the debit-card channel. A returned credit-card or bank-debit payment does not count against this allowance.

**What are "the last three months"?** A debit-card payment falls in them when fewer than three whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month. On a handling date of 2026-10-10, 2026-07-11 is inside and 2026-07-10 is not.

**Does an account that never paid by debit card get anything?** Yes: with no debit-card payment ever returned and none in the last three months, the allowance is $100.00.

## Condition table

| A debit-card payment on the account ever returned | Debit-card payment received in the last three months | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | $200.00 |
| No | No | $100.00 |
| Yes | any | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- Debit-card payments on 2026-08-14 and 2026-09-14, none ever returned: $200.00.
- Only bank-debit payments, one of them returned NSF; no debit-card payment ever: $100.00.
- A debit-card payment charged back in 2024 and recent debit-card payments since: nothing.
